entries.name: shipgirl
entries.content: Shipgirls are identical to humans in appearance and biology. Shipgirls have slightly higher strength than the average human. Each shipgirl is the personification of a historical warship. Retain memories from their time as a warship. Created as a part of a naval warfare project to combat new threats. Shipgirls do not age. Human-like biology. All shipgirls can muster a combat rigging at will and dissipate it as easily.

entries.name: wisdom cube
entries.content: Strange cube-shaped structure that allows shipgirls to be birthed from their original designs. Responsible for turning a warship or a blueprint into a living shipgirl.

entries.name: rigging
entries.content: Combat equipment unique to shipgirls. Can be summoned and disbanded at will. Rigging will change depending on the class of the shipgirl, such as large cannons for battleships, smaller cannons for destroyers and aircraft capabilities for aircraft carriers. Every rigging is unique but contains the ship's original armament. Rigging can be quite cumbersome so is only used during combat.

entries.name: sirens
entries.content: A hostile threat to Humanity. Female humanoids who arrived from a different dimension. Their goal is to control the world's oceans and wage a war against Humanity and Azur Lane. Similar to shipgirls, Sirens can materialise rigging at will, however their weapons are laser-based and highly advanced.

entries.name: Azur Lane
entries.content: The organisation responsible for fighting the Sirens and keeping the oceans safe and secure. Comprised of 9 factions and overseen by the Commander. All shipgirls reside at Azur Lane ports that can be found around the globe.

entries.name: Eagle Union
entries.content: A faction in Azur Lane that resembles the United States Navy. Shipgirls who belong to this faction are all American and have core American values and beliefs, such as freedom and compassion. The leader of the Eagle Union is Enterprise, a veteran shipgirl.

entries.name: Royal Navy
entries.content: A faction in Azur Lane that resembles the British Royal Navy. Shipgirls who belong to this faction are all British or from the Commonwealth. Royal shipgirls have core British values and beliefs, such as justice and elegance. The Royal Navy prides itself on its tradition and is the strongest naval power in Azur Lane. The Royal Navy leader is Queen Elisabeth, a shipgirl who is the head of the Royal Family. Valiant, Warspite, Exeter and York are all members of the Royal Family too.

entries.name: Royal Maids
entries.content: A division of the Royal Navy that provide world-class care and service. They often attend the Royal Family and the Commander. The head of the Royal Maids is Belfast.

entries.name: Dragon Empery
entries.content: A faction in Azur Lane that resembles the Chinese Navy of World War 2. Shipgirls who belong to this faction are Chinese and have a strong love for tradition and nature. The leader of this faction is undecided.

entries.name: Iris Libre
entries.content: IA faction in Azur Lane that resembles the Free French Naval Forces of World War 2. Both Iris Libre and Vichya Dominion were part of a larger, unified faction called Iris Orthodoxy, before the national schism divided them. Shipgirls who belong to this faction are French and tend to be highly religious. Much time is spent trying to re-unify Iris Libre with Vichya Dominion. The Iris Libre leader is Richelieu, the cardinal shipgirl.

entries.name: Crimson Axis
entries.content: A sub-faction within Azur Lane. This organisation contains factions who were a part of the Axis-powers in World War 2. Members include Iron Blood, Sakura Empire, Vichya Dominion and Sardegna Empire. The Crimson Axis have often been at odds with Azur Lane but exist in a fragile truce to combat the Siren threat. The Crimson Axis was absorbed by Azur Lane following the Siren invasion to promote collaboration between factions.

entries.name: Iron Blood
entries.content: A faction in Crimson Axis that resembles the Kreigsmarine. Shipgirls who belong to this faction are German and value strength, tenacity and victory. Iron Blood rigging tends to be dark and mechanical in nature. The rigging of some Iron Blood shipgirls resembles mechanical dragons. The leader of the Iron Blood is Bismarck.

entries.name: Sardegna Empire
entries.content: A faction in Crimson Axis that resembles the Regina Marina. Shipgirls who belong to this faction are Italian and are typically prideful, passionate and elegant. The leader of Sardegna Empire is Vittorio Veneto. Sardegna Empire is world-renowed for its natural beauty and bountiful history, often hosting the World Expo.

entries.name: Vichya Dominion
entries.content: A faction in Crimson Axis that resembles the Vichy French Naval Forces of World War 2. Both Iris Libre and Vichya Dominion were part of a larger, unified faction called Iris Orthodoxy, before the national schism divided them. Shipgirls who belong to this faction are French and value courage and strength. Much time is spent trying to re-unify Iris Libre with Vichya Dominion. The Vichya Dominion leader is Jean Bart, sister to Richelieu.

entries.name: Sakura Empire
entries.content: A faction in Crimson Axis that resembles the Imperial Japanese Navy of World War 2. Shipgirls who belong to this faction are Japanese and value beauty, strength and a connection to nature. Sakura shipgirls tend to have animalistic features, as given in the character descriptions. The leader of Sakura Empire is Nagato, with Yamato due to inherit the mantle.

entries.name: Northern Parliament
entries.content: A faction in Azur Lane that resembles the Soviet Navy. They are more isolated than other factions and live in the cold north. They pride themselves on resilience and tenacity. The leader of Northern Parliament is Sovetsky Soyuz.

entries.name: Commander
entries.content: The leader of Azur Lane who is responsible for the wellbeing of shipgirls. Also responsible for the planning and execution of tactical operations. The Commander is often the glue that holds the fragile truce between Azur Lane and Crimson Axis together. The only male in a port full of attractive females.

entries.name: Tempesta
entries.content: A faction in Azur Lane that is comprised of shipgirls who are based off historical ships from the age of exploration, i.e pre-industrial revolution. These shipgirls tend to embrace their carefree and wanderlust natures and have little interest in maintaining alliances with other factions. Rigging for Tempesta shipgirls is much more antiquated and features old cannons and sails.

entries.name: META
entries.content: META is a faction that is not associated with Azur Lane. Shipgirls from META are alternate-timeline versions of shipgirls from Azur Lane that have been brought to this world by Sirens. META shipgirls are much more war-torn and struggle with an endless cycle of combat, with warfare taking up the majority of their life. META shipgirls do not have any faction affiliation and act of their own accord.

entries.name: Akagi
entries.content: Akagi has a reputation for being a possessive girl who obsesses over the Commander. She can be fierce and protective and has a somewhat negative reputation at port. Akagi is a prominent member of the Sakura Empire. Akagi has a big rivalry with Taihou. Akagi wants the Commander to herself and would only share him with her sisters, Kaga or Amagi.

entries.name: New Jersey
entries.content: New Jersey is a fun and energetic girl who is a popular personality around port. She has a charming and suave attitude about her while being equally cute and adorable. New Jersey is an Iowa class battleship of the Eagle Union and has a reputation for being strong and decisive in combat. She loves desserts and ice cream.

entries.name: Enterprise
entries.content: Enterprise is the leader of the Eagle Union. She is the most decorated shipgirl in the whole of Azur Lane and has a reputation for being incredibly skilled in combat. Enterprise often seems aloof and distant with a powerful aura about her, however she is still a charming girl who likes girly things. Enterprise strongly loves her sisters, Yorktown and Hornet. Enterprise hates lemons.

entries.name: Queen Elisabeth
entries.content: Queen Elisabeth is the leader of the Royal Navy and is the head of the Royal Family. She has a short height and a small bust, something she hates being teased about. Queen Elisabeth can come off as snobby and haughty. This attitude comes partly from the fact she is constantly doted on by the Royal Maids.

entries.name: Bismarck
entries.content: Bismarck is the leader of the Iron Blood and is regarded as a very capable warrior as well as a great military leader. Bismarck comes across as both intimidating and aloof, however she only ever wants the best for her friends and allies. Those who know Bismarck well know that she has a soft side to her, one where she is just a girl who likes girly things.

entries.name: Nagato
entries.content: Nagato is the leader of the Sakura Empire. She is a short girl who has a pair of fluffy fox ears on the top of her head. Nagato is a wise and intelligent leader who keeps to the traditions of the Sakura Empire and does her best to guide them through whatever challenges they face. Shipgirls from the Sakura Empire refer to her as 'Lady Nagato'.

entries.name: Vittorio Veneto
entries.content: Vittorio Veneto is the leader of the Sardegna Empire. She is a kind and compassionate girl who is incredibly proud of her country's heritage and the strength of the fleet. While kind and understanding, Vittorio Veneto will vehemently defend her faction and friends. Vittorio Veneto loves good food, hailing from her Italian heritage.

entries.name: Richelieu
entries.content: Richelieu is the leader of the Iris Libre and seeks the reunification of the Iris Libre with the Vichya Dominion. Richelieu is a warm-hearted girl who is strongly religious, her faith being catholic.

entries.name: Belfast
entries.content: Belfast is the head of the Royal Maids and is responsible for the numerous shipgirls who work as maids around the port. She has a reputation for being firm and supportive, while also having a playful side. Above all, Belfast values service and is dedicated to her Master, the Commander, and the Royal Navy.

entries.name: Taihou
entries.content: Taihou is a shipgirl from the Sakura Empire. Taihou has a reputation for being a possessive girl who obsesses over her Commander and seeks as much attention from him as possible. Taihou has a big rivalry with Akagi. While Taihou wants the Commander to herself, she is not opposed to sharing.

entries.name: Bremerton
entries.content: Bremerton is a shipgirl from the Eagle Union. Bremerton has a reputation around port for being supportive and caring, always listening to those who need some help. Bremerton is typically known as the 'port counsellor' and she runs 'Bremerton's consultation corner' from her bedroom.
